title: Add V6.0.0 release foundation planning docs
summary: Added a V6.0.0 release-foundation planning pack under Docs/implementation/v6-release-foundation, linked it from Docs/DOCS_INDEX.md, and added an advisory document-location helper script.
reason: Future agents need small, controlled execution briefs for the V6.0.0 portable Tauri release without creating a new source of truth or confusing active docs with historical material.
behavior_before: The V6.0.0 release foundation existed only as conversation-level planning, and there was no helper for suggesting active Docs/ locations for new Markdown files.
behavior_after: The release foundation is captured as phase-specific Markdown under the implementation docs folder, Docs/DOCS_INDEX.md links the pack, and scripts/dev/suggest_doc_location.py can suggest active Docs/ folders or require a manual decision.
